headline: I am a recent graduate in Environmental Studies and Energy from Yale University. I have recently developed a love for environmental technology and I am keen to help implement the world's scientific solutions.
intro: I have built internal tools, dashboards and AI-assisted workflows for the parts of a business that usually live in spreadsheets and inboxes: sales prep, site screening, client operations and finance.
body: Most of my projects start the same way: a small team doing important work by hand, with the knowledge spread across documents, websites and people's heads. I like observing those teams and building tools to automate or speed up their workflows.

focus.title: Operations tools
focus.body: CRMs, dashboards and workflow apps that replace spreadsheets and manual prep for small teams.

focus.title: Grounded AI
focus.body: LLM features with citations, schema checks and rule-based fallbacks, so the output is something you can act on.

focus.title: Data and maps
focus.body: Geospatial pipelines, scoring models and visualisations that turn public data into shortlists and decisions.

cta: Want to talk about a project, or a role where I could build tools like these?

personal.heading: Outside work
personal.body: Outside of work, I love playing rugby, I joined Beantown when I moved to Boston. Prior to that I rowed at Yale, fortunate to have enjoyed the crisp autumn rows on the Housatonic River.
